title: Repertoire for Mabel's show
summary: The group played routines for her dance and some standard numbers.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Well I was going to ask one more question about that first band on that show, you know, with Mamie Lane and all. What kind of music did you play? Did you just play for her singing or did you play other pieces too?

Yeah, we had a regular routine, yeah. We had, she had numbers that we played for her to dance by, you know. And we used to play roles, not rolling, we used to play on the Rowdy League. Oh yeah, Rowdy League. Yeah, we played that, she used to dance that. Then we had a couple of band numbers we done, you see.
Some of the New Orleans numbers?
Yeah, yeah. Standard numbers. Yeah, yeah, that's right, yeah. Pretty good it was too.
